text:
Gold Price in 1977
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1977, the LBMA gold price rose 24.7% between 1977-01-31 ($132) and 1977-12-30 ($165). The highest sampled price was $165 in December and the lowest was $132 in January. The mean of these observations was $149. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
